sources.title: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct · Models
sources.snippet: Note: Having a separate repo for ONNX weights is intended to be a temporary solution until WebML gains more traction. If you would like to make your models web-ready, we recommend converting to ONNX using 🤗 Optimum and structuring your repo like this one (with ONNX weights located in a subfolder named onnx).

sources.title: GitHub - Zerkahlo/qwen2.5
sources.snippet: To pull a model checkpoint and run the model, use the ollama run command. You can specify a model size by adding a suffix to qwen2.5, such as :0.5b, :1.5b, :7b, or :72b:
